Upper end on trailing RAV: UK Power Networks 1.73x and Western Power Distribution 1.67x in the independent financial adviser's precedent table of CKI's circular (8 Apr 2026, pp.46-47).
A Parliament-set compensation at RAV (Labour, Bringing Energy Home, 2019: compensation decided by Parliament on the Northern Rock precedent, with possible deductions); not a market value.

Sensitivity requested by the user (2 Oct 2026): a 25% premium over RAV, between the listed market's minority-stake price (low, 20%) and recent full-control sales (central, 50%); close to the policy literature's 1.3x rule of thumb (see low). Not itself a deal precedent.
